beam.description: Analytic lightning / laser between two points.

origin_node.description: node whose world position overrides origin

target_node.description: node whose world position overrides target

branch_length.description: fraction of the main beam length

duration.description: active duration; -1 = until the end of the effect

phase.description: timeline phase name; when set it overrides start_time/duration

start_time.description: effect time at which the node becomes active

camera.description: Preview camera; tools use it by default.

collider.description: A collision shape particles and volumes test against.

rotation.description: euler angles, applied X then Y then Z

curve.description: A path used by emitters, trails, beams and motion.

rotation.description: euler angles, applied X then Y then Z

decal.description: A projected sprite on the ground or a surface.

duration.description: active duration; -1 = until the end of the effect

phase.description: timeline phase name; when set it overrides start_time/duration

projection_normal.description: surface normal the decal projects along

rotation.description: euler angles, applied X then Y then Z

start_time.description: effect time at which the node becomes active

emitter.description: Produces particles for one particle_system, or acts as a source for a volume.

particle.description: the particle system this emitter spawns into (not required when feeding a volume)

burst_count.description: particles emitted at each burst time

direction.description: local direction; zero vector = radial from shape center

duration.description: active duration; -1 = until the end of the effect

inherit_velocity.description: fraction of the emitter's own velocity added

phase.description: timeline phase name; when set it overrides start_time/duration

rotation.description: euler angles, applied X then Y then Z

start_time.description: effect time at which the node becomes active

surface_only.description: emit on the surface instead of the volume

event.description: Triggers bursts on target emitters when something happens.

burst_count.description: override burst on targets (0 = the target's own burst_count)

inherit_position.description: spawn at the triggering particle position

field.description: Sampled data grid (V1 evaluates only noise fields).

force.description: A force field applied to particles and volumes.

duration.description: active duration; -1 = until the end of the effect

phase.description: timeline phase name; when set it overrides start_time/duration

radius.description: 0 = infinite; falloff applies inside the radius

start_time.description: effect time at which the node becomes active

light.description: A dynamic light the effect casts onto the scene.

duration.description: active duration; -1 = until the end of the effect

phase.description: timeline phase name; when set it overrides start_time/duration

rotation.description: euler angles, applied X then Y then Z

start_time.description: effect time at which the node becomes active

material.description: Surface description shared by particles, meshes, trails, beams and decals.

soft_particle.description: depth fade against the depth buffer

temperature_gradient.description: when non-empty, remaps luminance/temperature to color

mesh.description: A renderable mesh, an emitter shape or a particle instance source.

duration.description: active duration; -1 = until the end of the effect

irregularity.description: crystal/rock/shard: how far the generator strays from the ideal shape

phase.description: timeline phase name; when set it overrides start_time/duration

primitive.description: built-in primitive; crystal/rock/shard are procedural and seeded

rotation.description: euler angles, applied X then Y then Z

start_time.description: effect time at which the node becomes active

variants.description: crystal/rock/shard: how many seeded variants to bake; other primitives ignore it

visible.description: false = geometry source only, never drawn

noise.description: Parameter provider for forces and textures.

particle_system.description: Defines what a particle is: initial state, evolution over life, rendering.

align_to_velocity.description: orient the billboard along the velocity

kill_on_collision.description: destroy the particle on the first collision

mesh_scale.description: render_mode=mesh: per-axis multipliers on top of size

mesh_scale_variance.description: +/- uniform per axis on mesh_scale (result clamped to >= 0.05)

orientation.description: render_mode=mesh: how the instanced mesh is oriented in 3D

physics.description: rigid selects Tier 2 (V1 falls back to Tier 1)

tilt.description: orientation=upright|velocity: per-particle random lean of the up axis, uniform in [0, tilt] around a random azimuth

duration.description: active duration; -1 = until the end of the effect

phase.description: timeline phase name; when set it overrides start_time/duration

start_time.description: effect time at which the node becomes active

texture.description: Procedural texture graph or file, baked by the compiler.

columns.description: flipbook grid layout of a file texture; frames become columns*rows

rows.description: flipbook grid layout of a file texture; frames become columns*rows

trail.description: A ribbon following a source node or a particle.

duration.description: active duration; -1 = until the end of the effect

phase.description: timeline phase name; when set it overrides start_time/duration

start_time.description: effect time at which the node becomes active

volume.description: A bounded volume: a procedural raymarched density field (mode: procedural) or, later, a fluid simulation (mode: simulation, a V1 stub that reports statistics). See docs/VOLUMES.md.

forces.description: forces applied to the velocity field

carve.description: density threshold: higher carves more holes

climb.description: upward advection of the noise field

density.description: overall opacity per metre (injected density in simulation mode)

duration.description: active duration; -1 = until the end of the effect

emission.description: HDR emission multiplier (bloom feeds on it)

march_steps.description: quality/speed knob (a backend may clamp it)

mode.description: procedural = raymarched closed-form density; simulation = the future fluid solver (W104)

phase.description: timeline phase name; when set it overrides start_time/duration

rotation.description: euler angles, applied X then Y then Z

scatter.description: single-scatter lighting weight from scene lights

shape.description: bounding shape of the procedural field

softness.description: edge falloff of the bounding shape

start_time.description: effect time at which the node becomes active

strands.description: 0 = soft clouds, 1 = stringy filaments (ridged noise blend)

validation_codes.E011: multi-input given to a single port
validation_codes.E016: timeline phase invalid (end<=start or outside duration)
validation_codes.E019: curve/gradient keys not sorted or out of [0,1]
validation_codes.E022: control binds to an unknown node or parameter
validation_codes.E023: control op does not fit the parameter type
validation_codes.E024: control range invalid (min>=max, value/default outside it, step<=0)
validation_codes.W002: unused node (no consumer and not renderable)
validation_codes.W006: keyframe set on a parameter not marked animatable
